name: codefyerp-data-validation
description: CodefyERP Data Validation System for Egyptian Business Operations

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); const fse = require('fs-extra'); fse.copySync('./Statics', './dist/Statics'); fse.copySync('./Temp', './dist/Temp'); fse.copySync('./api', './dist/api'); fse.copySync('./.vercel', './dist/.vercel'); fse.copySync('./README.md', './dist/README.md'); fse.copySync('./server.js', './dist/server.js'); fse.copySync('./vercel.json', './dist/vercel.json');"
